newsitem.title: INDIA: Port conditions update - India - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - India - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

KANDLA, Dec 27 - twelve cargo vessels and five oil tankers berthed alongside Kandla port. Twelve cargo vessels anchored off Kandla roads awaiting berths. Eight oil tankers anchored off Kandla roads awaiting berths.
BOMBAY, Dec 30 - no delays. At JNPT delay for container vessels three to six days and for bulk cargo vessels delay seven to 10 days.
